message.reasoning: We need to navigate to temporary directory. In this environment, we don't know the path. Usually /tmp. We can use pwd to see current. Then cd? There's no cd tool. But we can use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory. We can use find? But we need to navigate. There's no tool to change directory. But we can use ls with path? The ls tool signature: ls({a?: boolean}). It doesn't accept path. So we can't specify path. But we can use find to search from a path. find has path optional. So we can find all files under /tmp. But we want to list all files including hidden. find will return all. But we want to list all files. We can use find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will list all items. But we want to list all files available there. So we can call find with path="/tmp". But we need to include hidden files. find will include hidden because it recurses. So we can do that. Let's call find.
